recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26550; future changes to the workflowStatusDescription extension definition should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-26550 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request raised against the R4 ValueSet extension valueset-workflowStatus and applied for R5. It asked to change the extension name to valueset-workflowStatusDescription because the extension value is a string description rather than a coded workflow status.
initial_application: The first R5 VSD-profile implementation attempt in 9fca6ca36f included FHIR-26550 but was reverted. The second attempt in 054eabf311 renamed the ValueSet extension source to structuredefinition-extension-valueset-workflowStatusDescription.xml, and b89a83b4b7 corrected the ValueSet.status comment to link to the renamed extension.
additional_context: ValueSet remains active in core, and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml already references the workflowStatusDescription canonical. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed ValueSet extension definitions from core, including workflowStatusDescription. The FHIR Extension Pack contains the renamed StructureDefinition and retains the retired valueset-workflowStatus artifact with a replacement note. FHIR-26069 is the same rename request resolved as a duplicate of FHIR-26550 and is already audited on the combined branch; FHIR-31955 is a later wording issue for the same extension family and is also already audited.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current FHIR core checkout does not own the extension definition, and its in-scope ValueSet reference is already consistent with the applied rename.
